learning_outcomes.text: Performing operations, maintenance, service, system integration.
Definition of basic concepts regarding the operation and maintenance of electromechanical systems.
Identification and selection of components for operation, maintenance and integration in electromechanical systems.
Use of methods and technical means for increasing the reliability of electromechanical systems.
Identifying the objectives to be achieved, the resources available, the conditions for completion, the working steps, the working times, the related implementation deadlines and the related risks.

Effective use of information and communication resources and assisted training (portals, Internet, specialized software applications, databases, on-line courses) both in Romanian and in an international language.
Acquire fundamental knowledge of engineering graphics, universal language of communication in the technical field.
Acquire basic knowledge in the field of orthogonal representation, obtaining the true size, geometric elements and the deployments defining the technical parts.
Learn the rules of representation, grading and scoring of technical drawings, according to the world-wide rules through ISO, using the computer using AutoCAD software.
Acquaint students with practical aspects of drawing technical drawings using the computer using AutoCAD software.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of the AutoCAD operating mode. The AutoCAD User Interface. Launching orders. Data input. Selecting objects. Display Control. Establishing the drawing environment. End of work session.

Use basic commands for drawing, editing, and specifying entity-specific points. Draw commands for base entities. Commands used to modify and edit drawings. Using Object Snap Modes (Object SNAP). Selection sets.
Orders for making connections and bevels. Orders that allow copying, moving, scaling, and splitting entities.

General rules for the execution of the technical drawings Lines used in the technical drawing. Formats of technical drawings. Indicator. Numerical scales used in the technical drawing. Standardized writing. Representations used in industrial design: Representation in double and triple orthogonal point projection.
Orthogonal representation of the straight. Double Orthogonal Projection of the Straight. Triple Orthogonal Projection of Straight.

Rules for the representation and marking of views and sections. Layout of the projections in the plan. Classification of views. Section representation of parts. Classification of sections. Notation of section sectioning path.
Use of commands for quoting drawings. Rules and quotation rules. Elements of quote. Symbols used for enrolling quotas. Quoting specific elements. Classification of allowances. Quoting methods.
Quoting drawings with AutoCAD. Configuring Query Elements. Print text. Text style. Text input.
Viewing a drawing. Hatching and representing breaks. Study some drawing display commands. Hatching. Hatch styles. Representation of ruptures.
Using Layers. Layer Definition. Create and modify layers. Determining the color and layer type of layers. Define blocks. Studying commands for creating and inserting blocks into AutoCAD.

Elements of 3D Modeling and Visualization. Introduction to 3D modeling. Types of three-dimensional models. Superficial models. Coordinate systems in 3D. Creating surfaces. Modeling solids. Generating Solids. Editing Solid Objects. Quoting in 3D.
Modeling solids. Generating Solids. Editing Solid Objects. Quoting in 3D.
Modeling in three-dimensional space.
Construction of surface solids modeling three-dimensional solids.
Presentation of the laboratory, labor protection norms and applications the laboratory works.
Execution of drawings using absolute, relative, polar coordinates and LINE, GRID, SNAP, ERASE commands.
Realization of the sandarded A3 drawing format and the indicator.
Representations in double and orthogonal projection of the point Representations in double orthogonal projection of the right.
Making drawings using editing commands with the specification of some attachment points.
Representation in view using the rules of representation and notation of views.
Representation of the drawings in section in compliance with the indicated sectioning paths.
Configuring the dimension elements. Drawing drawings.
Applications with the exercise of the main editing commands: Breack, Offset, Extens, Fillet, Chamfer, Array.
Combining drawing and editing commands to obtain the desired model.
Dimensioning drawings in interactive graphics and using non-graphic elements such as texts, tables, symbols.
Making a three-dimensional 3D drawing.
Recovery of laboratory works.
Assessment of knowledge acquired during laboratory hours.
teaching_methods: Free exposure with course presentation on video projector and on blackboard
Written materials with presentation of practical work for laboratory applications
Computer network and AutoCAD program for practical applications
assessment_rules: For a grade of 5 in the course, fundamental notions are required without presenting details; for a grade of 10, thorough knowledge of all topics is required. For a grade of 5 in the laboratory, recognition of stands used in practical work is required without details; for a grade of 10, detailed knowledge of the practical realization method of all laboratory work is required. Minimum performance standards include participation in at least half of the courses and the ability to make a technical drawing according to technical standards using AutoCAD.
